name: Arabidopsis radiation exposure classifier (OSD-46)
task: Binary irradiated-versus-control classification from seedling expression

classDescription.irradiated: 100 Gy gamma or 30 Gy Fe-56, pooled

expressionUnits: log2 normalised Affymetrix intensities, gene-model collapsed by mean
method: logistic_l2 with in-fold ANOVA gene selection
validation: Leave-one-biological-group-out cross-validation over 22 groups. Gene filtering and ANOVA selection fitted inside each training fold only. Labels permuted between groups for the null.

bootstrapCi.method: stratified percentile bootstrap over held-out predictions

bestOverallLearner.name: hist_gradient_boosting
bestOverallLearner.note: Best learner among all five families. Tree ensembles cannot be serialised into the dependency-free evaluator, so the shipped artifact is the best linear learner instead.

batchConfound.interpretation: Association between array processing batch and the class label. Controls do not appear on the batch holding 20 of the 44 arrays, so part of the separation could be array handling rather than irradiation.

supplementaryEvaluation.rationale: Controls never appear on batch 1006A-03, which holds 20 of the 44 arrays, so condition is associated with array batch (Cramer's V 0.506). Batch 0806A-10 is the only batch containing all three conditions, so evaluating there removes the confound by construction. This is the figure to quote.

domain.note: Supply log2 normalised expression for every gene in 'features'. Partial vectors are rejected rather than zero-filled.

referenceProfilesNote: Per-class mean of the training expression across the selected genes. These are class centroids computed from NASA OSD-46 data, NOT individual measured samples, and using one as model input is a synthetic input that must be labelled as such.
limitations: Ground-based irradiation of Arabidopsis seedlings, not spaceflight and not a crop.

Non-irradiated controls appear on only two of the three array batches and never on the batch holding 20 of the 44 arrays, so condition is associated with array batch (Cramer's V 0.506 on the full set).
The batch-controlled evaluation on batch 0806A-10 alone is reported in supplementaryEvaluation and should be preferred over the full-set figure.
Mixes two radiation qualities and two absorbed doses into one label; it does not separate quality from dose.
Never predicts yield, biomass, survival or crop productivity; no such measurement exists in this study.
recommendedUse: Evidence that an irradiation-exposure signature is recoverable, reported alongside a batch-controlled evaluation because the control class is not batch-balanced.

phase10.explanationMethod: exact linear attribution of the served linear-softmax evaluator; the contributions reconstruct the served logits

sourceCitation: NASA Open Science Data Repository, OSD-46: Gamma radiation and HZE treatment of seedlings in Arabidopsis (UC Davis / Brookhaven).
servedScope: Irradiated versus non-irradiated classification for Arabidopsis seedlings in OSD-46. Controls do not appear on the array batch holding 20 of the 44 arrays, so part of the separation may be array handling; the response reports the batch-controlled supplementary figure as the one to quote.
note: No operational forecast. This card describes what the model reproduces inside the measured domain; it is not a prediction of a future or unmeasured crop.

probabilityCalibration.method: Leave-one-biological-group-out out-of-fold probabilities, the same split as the reported accuracy. Log loss, Brier score and a 10-bin ECE were measured; a nested temperature search was run and reported.
probabilityCalibration.scope: Measured within OSD-46 only, and the class balance is confounded with array batch.
probabilityCalibration.statement: The class probabilities are uncalibrated scores. Controls do not appear on the array batch holding 20 of the 44 arrays, so neither the score nor its calibration can separate irradiation from array handling.

evidenceVerdict.reason: Only within-study or within-campaign performance is recorded; no independent campaign has scored this model.
